standard.summary: 智能 LR 衰减触发时，学习率乘以的系数。默认 0.5（减半）。
standard.whenToUse: 默认 0.5 稳健。若平台期后希望温和调整可改为 0.7~0.8。

standard_en.summary: Factor the learning rate is multiplied by when smart LR decay fires. Default 0.5, i.e. halved.
standard_en.effect: 0.5 halves it each time; 0.7 is a gentle 30% cut; 0.3 is an aggressive drop to 30%.
standard_en.whenToUse: The default 0.5 is the robust choice. Use 0.7 to 0.8 if you want a gentler nudge after a plateau.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not set it to 0 or to 1.0.

advanced.principle: new_lr = current_lr * ac_lr_decay_factor，应用于所有参数组，永久生效。
advanced.tradeoffs: 多次触发后 LR 呈指数衰减：3 次 × 0.5 → 原 LR 的 12.5%。

advanced_en.principle: new_lr = current_lr * ac_lr_decay_factor, applied to all parameter groups, permanently.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Repeated triggers decay LR exponentially: 3 × 0.5 → 12.5% of the original LR.
